context: A boss and his manager discuss difficult news headlines
purpose: Teach: 大都市/過激/騒音/核兵器/虐殺/性別/死ね/無関係

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今朝の新聞を見たか。大都市での騒音問題がまた一面だ。
lines.en: Did you see this morning's paper? Big city noise issues are on the front page again.
lines.style: Gruff senior executive tone, terse and direct.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、読みました。でも、もっと気になったのは過激な発言の記事です。
lines.en: Yes, I read it. But what concerned me more was the article on extreme remarks.
lines.style: Polite middle-manager register, measured and respectful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、あの政治家か。性別を問わず、誰に対しても暴言だ。ひどいものだな。
lines.en: Ah, that politician. Insults toward everyone regardless of gender. Truly awful.
lines.style: Disgusted older boss, blunt and weary delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 「死ねばいい」とまで言ったそうですよ。信じられません。
lines.en: Apparently he even said things like 'they should just die.' Unbelievable.
lines.style: Shocked manager voice, hushed and disturbed tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 国際面はもっと暗いぞ。核兵器の話に、また集団虐殺の報道だ。
lines.en: The international page is darker. Talk of nuclear weapons, and reports of mass killings.
lines.style: Grave executive tone, heavy with resignation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本当に胸が痛みます。我々の業務とは無関係でも、無視はできませんね。
lines.en: It really pains me. Even though unrelated to our work, we can't ignore it.
lines.style: Reflective subordinate voice, sincere and somber delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: その通りだ。さあ、暗い話はここまで。仕事に戻ろう。
lines.en: Exactly right. Well, enough of the dark talk. Let's get back to work.
lines.style: Firm boss closing tone, brisk and decisive.
